subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should immediate text acknowledgment be a shared `messages.*` product contract, a generic plugin/channel SDK lifecycle, or remain limited to existing reaction and native-status signals?
rationale: The choice creates new configuration and delivery semantics across multiple channel owners, and current hooks do not settle ownership, continuation, cleanup, or compatibility behavior.

options.title: Add a generic channel lifecycle
options.body: Introduce a typed pre-run acknowledgment contract in the public channel SDK, keep native send/edit/delete behavior in channel plugins, and layer shared scope policy above it.

options.title: Add global ackText config
options.body: Implement `messages.ackText` centrally with per-channel/account overrides and require each supported channel to map the same lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Keep status-only feedback
options.body: Decline posted text acknowledgments and standardize reactions, typing, and native status surfaces as the supported liveness UX.

recommendation.title: Add a generic channel lifecycle
recommendation.body: Introduce a typed pre-run acknowledgment contract in the public channel SDK, keep native send/edit/delete behavior in channel plugins, and layer shared scope policy above it.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate across shared dispatch, acknowledgment lifecycle, channel delivery, and prior issue review context.
